preconditions.description: The length of the input word is between 1 and 100 characters.
The input word consists only of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == stdin.lower() if sum(c.islower() for c in stdin) >= sum(c.isupper() for c in stdin) else stdin.upper()
postconditions.description: The output word is in lowercase if the number of lowercase letters is greater than or equal to the number of uppercase letters, otherwise it is in uppercase.
